title: Re_Crafted
body:
Welcome to Modpack Minecraft Better

Minecraft Better [FABRIC] – The Ultimate Vanilla+ Experience

Minecraft Better is a carefully crafted Fabric modpack designed to enhance every aspect of your Minecraft journey while preserving the core vanilla experience. Built on Fabric's lightweight architecture, this pack delivers exceptional performance, meaningful content, and complete creative freedom.

🚀 Unmatched Performance:
The pack integrates industry-leading optimization mods including Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Starlight, and ImmediatelyFast. Experience higher FPS, reduced lag, faster chunk loading, and smoother gameplay even on low-end hardware. Load times are drastically improved, and world generation is faster than ever.

🎮 Quality of Life Improvements:
Enjoy essential QoL mods like Jade for entity information, Xaero's Minimap for navigation, Waystones for fast travel, and Inventory Profiles Next for one-click inventory sorting. Also includes Mouse Tweaks, BetterF3, AppleSkin, and many more.

🌍 Expanded World:
Explore hundreds of new biomes, caves, and over 300 new structures. The pack adds incredible variety to the Overworld, Nether, and End while staying true to the vanilla aesthetic. Every journey brings new discoveries.

⚔️ Meaningful Progression:
Level up your weapons and armor through use with the Levels system. Maintain a balanced diet with the Nutrition mod to gain powerful buffs. Choose up to 3 jobs simultaneously with the Jobs system, and team up with friends using the Party system to share experience and tackle challenges together.

🎨 Modern Visuals & UI:
Enjoy redesigned screens for inventory, crafting, mining, and alchemy. Add shaders via Iris for stunning visuals. Also includes 3D Skin Layers, Better Leaves, Connected Textures, and more.

Perfect for Vanilla lovers, low-end PC users, multiplayer enthusiasts, and explorers. Download Minecraft Better [FABRIC] today and rediscover your favorite game!
